car.name: Moschatel 2018
car.description: Romain Dumas, 24 June 2018 Pikes Peak record-winning Volkswagen I.D. R inspiration. Genuine native EV: combined 500 kW / 650 Nm, battery depletion and regeneration. Original plum/ivory art; battery capacity, reduction and control strategy are estimates, not 2019 specification.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Romain Dumas, Volkswagen I.D. R Pikes Peak, 24 June 2018 overall record winner. Not the revised 2019 Nurburgring/Goodwood/Tianmen configuration.

sources.access: Official organizer confirms Dumas in the all-electric I.D. R and 2018 overall record 7:57.148.

Volkswagen release specifies 24 June 2018 target event, two motors totaling 500 kW (680 PS), 650 Nm and under 1100 kg, 2.25 seconds 0-100 km/h depending on grip, lithium-ion storage and recovery context.

VW group release explains separate axle motors, two linked battery blocks beside/behind cockpit, active torque distribution and brake-by-wire regeneration. No usable kWh, reduction, RPM or calibration published here.

Manufacturer-authored 2018 technical sheet preserved on a third-party host: 5200/2350/1200 mm, 2850 mm wheelbase, 1600 mm track, 31/71-18 tires, less than 1100 kg including driver, approximate 240 km/h. English hp label corresponds to metric PS, so use 500 kW as canonical.

estimates: Native EV combines both motors into one constant-torque/constant-power envelope and fixed reduction. 40 kWh usable energy, 9:1 reduction, 18000 motor RPM, 1090 kg running mass, efficiencies, regen limits/lift-off behavior and 2.2-second 0-60 mph target are explicit simulation estimates. 1090 kg is a choice below the published 1100 kg bound including driver, not an event weigh-in. 2.25 seconds is OEM 0-100 km/h, not 0-60 mph.

Generic differential load sharing with 50 percent nominal rear bias does not reproduce active independent axle motor control. No authentic thermal, voltage, battery cooling, brake-by-wire blending, per-axle inverter control or charging simulation; no promise of 20 percent recovered energy or record time on a game course. Exact usable capacity and reduction remain unverified. Native battery energy genuinely depletes/recovers; empty battery stops propulsion. Motor RPM is not combustion RPM, and there is no multi-speed gearbox or combustion audio.

Geometry and tire envelope follow the manufacturer technical sheet; aero coefficients, suspension, CG, brake setup, pressure and collision envelope are estimates. Original midnight-plum/ivory/mint body and carbon single-seat cockpit are not copied silver-blue livery. Live speed, motor kW, direction gear and battery reserve, shared wheel/wipers and silent motor audio are game conventions. No shared runtime changes.
